requirements: Assess exact original stopped samples, preambles, headroom, AC RMS and periodicity alongside unchanged default and separate diagnostic receive results. If waveform supports a common range, draft and admit one new matched stock-derived-stock batch preserving frequency/return schedule, sampled RMS and original contrast criteria, source/cable/stock/protected invariants and one normal reboot per native transition. Declare the new common range and host coexistence fixture explicitly for all arms. Plan, inspect, expected-revision admission and commit/push before execution; independently review any changed eligibility boundary.

Continue through the evidence-supported frontier to verified or contradicted engineering effect or a genuine external dependency or deadline. Do not claim calibrated continuous analog bandwidth from selected-point sampled RMS. Preserve exact known-safe state and positively owned cleanup.
acceptance: An actual diagnostic finding and justified successor or exact terminal limitation are preserved.
